 import re
 import textwrap

 _NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
 
 
 def slug(text: str) -> str:
     """'Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'."""
+    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
